title: DeepMind AI Halves Storm Isaias Forecast Error 11 Days in Advance

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The FNV3 prediction system identified the precise point of impact for a late September weather event four days before landfall. This model from Google DeepMind detected an appreciable signal for the system on September 23 and consistently hit the peak intensity of the storm three days before it occurred. To determine track density and mean tracks, the tool utilized ensembles of 1,000 members and 50 members respectively.

These results for Storm Isaias represent a 50% reduction in forecasting errors, providing an expanded window for evacuation and safety warnings. The AI can maintain accuracy up to 11 days in advance, a development that proponents describe as a way for artificial intelligence to actively save lives during severe weather events.
